name: Cervical / Deep-End Orgasm (Belly Orgasm)
summary: A distinct climax from deep vaginal stimulation—especially sustained contact at the deep end—not the same as G-spot or clitoral orgasm. OMGYES reports about 15% of women have discovered this type; technique and patience matter more than force.

Success favors continuous contact, rocking, pulsing, or massaging with steady pressure through the whole cycle—lighter, deliberate touch on inner walls rather than slamming. Mastery usually takes repeated sessions across changing mood, energy, and stress levels.

5. Stay gentle and controlled on inner walls; depth alone does not create pleasure without the right pressure curve.
6. Repeat across sessions; note what pressure, angle, and depth work on a given day.
safety_notes: Deep pounding often causes cervical pain—stop immediately if sharp or bruising sensation occurs.
Cervical contact should be invited and gentle; never punch or ram depth.
Not all bodies enjoy deep stimulation; absence of this orgasm type is normal.
